items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Eddie Cole and yours truly [unintelligible] in this band over here from the [Unintelligible} High School

ctx.x: Yeah, see that‟s why Dexter Travis is so rich today [laughter]. Dexter Travis went to [Unintelligible] High School too but he couldn‟t get arrested because Nat Cole was there and Eddie Cole was there. Eddie Cole was the one we thought was most likely to succeed.
Right, he was supposed to be the better pianist in those days.
